column6: A vertical swipe that starts on the Foray strip seeks instead of scrolling
The Now Playing scrub bar has no touch-action, so dragging the thumb scrolls the sheet
The Continue banner's ✓ "Done with this" button has no handler and navigates instead
Chapter rows are a ~19px tap target although the CSS comment claims 48px
Up Next reorder arrows are 28x22px, stacked 2px apart
Per-segment thumbs are 30x30px, though a neighbouring comment sizes the layout around "the 44px-ish thumb target"
Inline description timestamps are zero-padding inline buttons that seek playback
Start over is a ~16px underlined target sitting 10px above the 12px scrub strip
Modal sheets with text inputs are stranded behind the soft keyboard
The mini player's artwork is a 40px dead target where every podcast app opens the player
The mini player's "Open player" button is ~35px tall inside a ~56px bar, with dead strips above and below
Every episode row stacks two unpadded navigation links ~2px apart
The mini player applies the home-indicator inset twice, leaving a dead band above the tab bar
A narration beat's play button is a 30px-tall strip
The Audition button inside a voice row is ~29px, and a miss silently changes the narration voice
Up Next's remove ✕ is a 32px destructive button crowded against the 22px reorder arrows
Row play and star buttons are 40x40, with the row's only other targets 10px away
Topbar menu and refresh buttons are 42x42
The sheet drag-dismiss gesture ignores pointerId, so a second finger restarts it mid-drag
The Now Playing sheet's collapse ✕ is 36x36
Scrubber and ±seek buttons are dead once playback has ended; the thumb silently snaps back
Dragging the Foray scrubber fully right disarms the out-point and free-plays into the source episode
A restored Now Playing ribbon installs no MediaSession handlers — the car/lock-screen play button does nothing
`ForayPlayer.play()` reports success even when the episode audio 404s, and nothing on screen says it failed
The Foray page's main button is painted from the stale belief, not the #689 authority — it says "Resume" while audio plays, and the press pauses
Every transport control except play/pause is dead on a restored ribbon, and a scrub there is silently discarded
An episode you just finished shows an empty progress bar and "60 min left" in Jump back in
Spoken narration bridges play at the listener's chosen speed, contradicting the 1.0x rule, and the Foray clock jumps at the seam
Mini-bar progress fill and scrub thumb keep the previous episode's position when the new duration is unknown
The in-list card's play glyph disagrees with the mini bar's during a seam beat and in the #689 drift case
Lock screen / car reports PAUSED while audio is coming out (the #689 drift is not fixed on the OS surface)
After a narration bridge the next segment loads cold — the jingle plays, then several seconds of unexplained silence
Timings on this show are approximate. can never appear
Two quick taps of "››" advance one segment and freeze the clock in between
30 ↻ has no upper clamp while "↺ 15" clamps at zero
›› on the last segment does nothing and is never disabled
Scrubbing into a narration bridge computes a NaN target and restarts the bridge from the top
A timestamp tap passes a string where the player expects `{ why }`
A finished Foray's main button says "▶ Resume" while the lock screen shows no transport at all
Remaining time reads "-0:00" at the exact end instead of settling at zero or saying finished
v1's light-mode palette leaks onto the permanently-dark ui-v2 page
Delete everything is violet like every other primary button — its red is overridden
Home's "Episodes for you" cards are v1: Georgia titles at 1.2rem beside Fraunces at 0.95rem
The stretch bridge line is injected inside .mini-card's flex row, so it lands beside the star button
Generated for you is amber on Home and violet on Search — and amber contradicts the documented split
The "Stretch" tag is blue on one Home card and violet on the next
The brand wordmark in the topbar is Georgia; the .wordmark rule written for it is never used
A Foray page's sticky transport pins behind the sticky page header
Home always scrolls by the height of the tab bar into empty background
The Create page's primary button is v1 blue; the identical button on Playlists is violet
Section labels on one page are half Fraunces, half Georgia
On a light-set device the segment strip's narration hatch turns black on a dark page
Search results show three row shapes, and the Playlists section's rows sit at double the gap
Tap a subject pills are two different components on two screens
N min left is gold on a Foray page and amber on Home
The menu's only coloured item is "Delete my data", in a retired v1 gold
v1 accent blue survives in five live v2 controls
Chapter rows, Foray rows and source links have hover-only feedback on a touch-first app
The same square artwork is flat-and-bordered on the Episode page and heavily lifted-and-unbordered in the Now Playing sheet
There is no radius scale: --radius is used 13 times out of 74, and one sheet contains four radii
Token values are duplicated as raw hex, so the palette can drift against itself
Clear-search ✕ is bound to mousedown only, so Enter/Space do nothing
The Foray segment strip is clickable but keyboard-unreachable and nameless
Every action in the Narration-voice sheet destroys the element that was just activated
Up Next reorder and remove rebuild the whole page, so focus is lost on every press
The voice-fallback hint is rewritten into an aria-live region four times a second
Star buttons' accessible names are frozen — and the show star's is inverted after one tap
A playing card's play button still announces "Play <title>" while it means Pause
The mini bar's info button hides the episode title from screen readers and lies about collapsing
No sheet in the app moves focus, traps Tab, or closes on Escape
The Now Playing sheet is a full-screen overlay with no dialog semantics at all
The scrub slider announces raw 0–1000 ticks instead of a time
Search results and result counts paint with no live region
Six text fields are labelled by placeholder alone
The Foray main button says "Resume" / "Loading…" but announces "Play"
Which Foray beat is playing, and which are done, is conveyed only visually
Down-vote reason chips signal selection with colour only, no aria-pressed
Play and star buttons are nested inside the anchors they sit on
ui-v2's --faint fails contrast on real copy and on the Up Next remove button
A route change moves no focus, announces nothing, and never updates the page title
Voice rows use an orphan radio role with a nested button and all rows as tab stops
`bindForayScripts` adds a click listener to the persistent `#view` on every Foray render, so "Show more" toggles N times per tap
Show page's "still mounted" check is not show-specific: show A's episodes, description and count paint onto show B's page
Leaving and re-entering #/shows does not supersede in-flight search passes, so the previous query's results paint onto an empty search box
`anyStale` is sticky and the unchanged-list early return skips the repaint, so the show page keeps saying "couldn't refresh just now" after a refresh that succeeded
A foreground directory refresh re-renders the whole show/Foray page under the listener, dropping a typed episode search and the keyboard
The "4a is showing its last saved copy" bar reappears after being dismissed, because the worker sends one `stale-shell` per code file
`syncCardButtons` rewrites a row's play glyph but never its `aria-label`, so a screen reader is told "Play <episode>" on a button that pauses
`_loadItem` stamps `_loadedId` before its supersession check, so a superseded load can claim the element and cost the listener their position on the next resume
`HtmlAudioBackend.load()` installs media listeners with no `_loadSeq` guard, so an overlapping load seeks the element to the abandoned segment's in-point
The Foray page's speed menu has no single-instance guard, so two taps stack two modals and one Cancel leaves the page covered
Auditioning a second narration voice before the first answers clears the spinner and can show the wrong voice-fallback notice
`body.fy-sheet-open` is in `PERSISTENT_BODY_CLASSES`, so the Foray feedback sheet leaves a modal scroll-lock class behind when the page navigates
Show page subtitle says "7 episodes" over a body that shows none — the 2026-09-21 fix broke its own premise
Up Next says "Episode no longer available" for every episode added from a show page
Library → History reads "No longer available" for every episode you actually played from a show page
Library → Saved renders a starred show-page episode as unplayable, though its snapshot carries audio_url
Shows search flashes "No results for X." on the keystroke, before any of the four network passes has run
#/forays says "0 forays" and "No forays right now" whenever the player module has not evaluated, and never corrects itself
Home is a bare greeting when any data file fails to load — a success state with zero content
Cold boot shows an empty page with no loading state at all
The Shows page's browse-subject pills land on "No results for …" for a third of the taxonomy
Showing shows available offline outlives the search it explained
Up Next auto-advance stops silently at any episode added from a show page
Episode not found. / "Show not found." / "Loading show…" pages have no back button
A show with zero episodes loses its publisher description
1 parts on three surfaces
Library's empty-playlists state points at a control Home no longer has
Episode rows show a dangling " · " when the feed carries no duration
#/shows reads "No shows here yet." when the catalogue file failed to load
The Now Playing sheet keeps an empty paragraph's worth of gap where the hook and the timing note would be
The playlist builder leaves the previous query's failure note up while building the next one
A cached show page claims "couldn't refresh just now" before any refresh has been attempted
Show A's episode list paints into show B's page — the "still mounted" guard only checks that *some* show page is on screen
Back-step scroll restore fires before async pages have painted, so the position is lost AND the memory is overwritten with 0
Reloading or sharing a subject-queue page (#/subject/:branch) says "Playlist not found" — the four branches are re-dealt at random on every load, with a penalty against the ones you just saw
After removing a playlist reached from anywhere but #/playlists, ‹ lands back on the playlist that was just deleted

A malformed percent-escape in a #/show/, #/category/ or #/foray/ hash throws out of route() — and on a cold load that kills init() before the hashchange listener is ever bound, so the whole app is dead until reload
#/playlist/ and #/subject/ are the two routes that still never decode their param, while one live link generator encodes it
Tapping a browse pill on the Search tab un-highlights the Search tab
The Interests page highlights no tab at all
An unrecognised hash renders the Home screen but lights no tab
Open episode on the restored now-playing bar leads to "Episode not found" for the episode that is playing
#/show/pi:<n> is a route the app links to that can never render after a reload
Every "not found" page is a dead end: no page-head, no ‹
Coming back from a show loses the show search you did to find it
Coming back from an episode loses the in-show episode search
Create a playlist about X inserts a phantom #/playlists step, so ‹ from the new playlist lands on a page the listener never visited
A ?foray= link permanently hijacks Home: reloading while on the home screen bounces back to the Foray
noteNavigation counts a forward tap onto the page two steps back as a back-step, so a tab tap restores an old scroll position instead of starting at the top
Tapping the tab you are already on does nothing — not even scroll to top
Three spellings of Home mean the first Home-tab tap of a session costs a dead back press
Clearing the show search leaves the query in the URL, so a reload or back-step brings it back
Error copy tells the listener to "Pull to refresh" — no pull-to-refresh exists anywhere
Library's empty playlist state sends the listener to a screen with no playlist builder
Home mini-card renders double punctuation: Starts with "…Save The World?."
The same playlist length is "N parts" on three screens and "N episodes" on two, and only one of the five pluralises
Stale-shell banner offers "Reload to get the current version" — the code's own comment says reloading reproduces the state
The product noun "Foray" is capitalised in half the user-facing strings and lowercase in the other half — including twice on one screen
Starred Shows on the page, "Starred shows" on the link that opens it
Browser-centric copy in a shipping native app: "Your browser held the audio back", "reload the page", "This browser has taken storage away"
An aged-out playlist part states its unavailability twice, in two different wordings, on one row
0 key(s) would not clear. — a lazy plural and developer jargon in the delete-my-data result
The Playlists page prints a raw locale date ("9/21/2026") while every other date in the app goes through fmtDate ("Sep 21, 2026")
A Foray's pieces are called segments, clips, parts and beats — all user-visible, sometimes on the same screen
Agent-generated Foray titles are Title Case with no closing period, next to sentence-case curated ones in the same rail
fmtDur renders an exact hour as "1h 0m" — 49 episodes in the shipped pool
On short screens the mini-card hook is clamped to one line, hiding the only concrete thing it says
today's queue and "a daily podcast picker" promise a daily cadence buildCards() does not have
The episode star announces "Save" — never the state, and in a different word from every other star surface
The same idea is "your usual topics" in one Home tooltip and "your usual subjects" in the bridge line beneath it
session.json's fit_line field carries four commute-length violations and no test gates it
Library's subtitle lists its sections in an order the page does not use, and page subtitles have three incompatible shapes
A write localStorage refuses but IndexedDB accepts is silently reverted on the next launch — and the good durable copy is overwritten with the stale one
Pressing play on an episode you already finished starts it ~15 seconds before the end — `_loadItem` reads the raw stored position, never `resumeOffset`
Restored mini bar shows 0:00 for a finished episode and then plays its last seconds — the restore path skips its seek when the offset is 0
Delete my data reports success while the entire local listening queue survives in a second IndexedDB database
A finished episode comes back to "Jump back in" claiming 0% played and the full runtime left
An hour in a Foray leaves the now-playing ribbon restoring a much older ordinary episode
A missing data/taxonomy.json wipes the listener's whole interests profile on their first play or thumb
The restored ribbon publishes lock-screen metadata with no action handlers and a 0:00 playhead
Restored mini bar shows "--:--" and a flat progress bar when the snapshot has no duration_sec, even though the position store recorded the real duration
Jump back in Foray rows compute percent and "min left" against the STORED runtime, never the live one
The jingle toggle's label snaps back while the session honours the flip, when the write is refused
Open episode from the restored ribbon says "Episode not found" when the app launches on any route but Home
1 parts on a one-part playlist's Jump back in card
On a cold launch where the player module evaluates after route(), "Jump back in" loses every Foray row and nothing ever repaints it
The stored playback speed can be lost for the whole session when hydration overruns app.js's 5-second race
Playing an item with no id erases the last-episode pointer instead of leaving it alone
`episodeRemainingLabel`'s "finished" state is unreachable from its only caller, and is lowercase where the rest of the rail is sentence case
Reading the playlist list mutates it: a playlist you never played is stamped `created: now`, so the drawer's recency order is invented at first read
The durable store advertises a Capacitor Preferences tier it does not have, so inside the iOS shell every tier is still script-writable
`refusedWrites` — the counter built to prove positions are being recorded — cannot increment against the durable store
A stale show list stays labelled "couldn't refresh" after the refresh succeeds
Jump back in tells you a finished episode has its whole runtime left
The Foray page prints two different segment counts, from two sources, one above the other
No results for X. renders directly above a full list of results
The Forays page asserts "0 forays" when the data or the player module failed to load
N segments can't play — listed below counts segments that are not listed below
41% of a Foray's advertised runtime is a character-count estimate shown as a measured clock
The "Open in" setting governs nothing — both link-out builders are dead
Episode rows print an empty field between two separators when the duration is unknown
Delete my data can report "This device is NOT fully clear. 0 key(s) would not clear."
An exactly-one-hour episode reads "1h 0m"
Three surfaces print "1 parts"; the fourth, in the same file, prints "1 part"
The Foray header counts shows that will never be heard; the credit block below counts only the ones that will
A category page claims a category is empty when catalog-client.json failed to load
Home's playlist card counts parts from a different source than every other surface
A playlist's "N played" silently decreases as the 200-entry history ring rotates
There is nothing to clear on this page is also what a failed clear says
The subject-card duration silently omits episodes whose length is unknown
played <date> is formatted in local time by a raw toLocaleDateString, and can read "Invalid Date"
Home's greeting is computed once per render and goes stale on a page left open
